item.pw_wind_n_sails.sailboat.desc: Single-mast sailing boat steered with mouse, sheet trimmed with W/S, and weight balanced with A/D.
item.pw_wind_n_sails.sport_sailboat.desc: 4.5m sleek white racing boat equipped with a tall aluminium mast, high-aspect mainsail, and working jib.
item.pw_wind_n_sails.anchor.desc: Throw the anchor into the water by right-clicking (45° angle upwards gives ~10 blocks range). Tether the lead to any cleat to moor securely.
item.pw_wind_n_sails.buoy.desc: Spherical mooring and signal buoy (0.75m diameter). Thrown with its anchor to mark navigation channels or moor boats. Visible on Xaero's World Map.
item.pw_wind_n_sails.cylindrical_buoy.de: Tall cylindrical mooring and fairway buoy (1m height, 0.7m diameter). Thrown with its anchor. Visible on Xaero's World Map.
item.pw_wind_n_sails.flagpole.desc: 7-block mast with a wind flag. Each pole is built with a random flag color.
